settings.heading: What we make
settings.text: Mintmark publishes the “Living Company DNA” series — books that dissect one real, publicly traded company per volume. The world’s most complicated ideas, taught the world’s simplest way. Each book delivers genuine financial depth in language a 10-year-old can follow without a dictionary. The standard is simple to state and hard to achieve: CEO-complete underneath, Khan-clear on top.

settings.heading: Who it's for
settings.text: Children ages 10–13 who are curious about the companies they already interact with every day. Parents who want their children to understand — not just hold — the investments in their accounts. Anyone who believes that real financial literacy starts with understanding how businesses actually work, not with memorizing ticker symbols.

settings.heading: The progression system
settings.text: Books are not just books. Each one ends with a minted coin — a numismatic collectible earned by demonstrating real understanding. Coins are collected in a Wallet. The Wallet grows as understanding does. The system is grounded in real numismatic tradition: a mintmark is the authenticating stamp on a coin that proves where and when it was struck. Here, it proves what you know.

settings.heading: The company
settings.text: We are a small team building a large catalog — toward the full S&P 500, one company at a time. The launch set covers nine flagship companies. The catalog grows from there.

settings.heading_accent: and mint the next generation of capitalists.
settings.intro_text: Mintmark turns real company stories into clear financial understanding, one company at a time.
settings.cta_text: Every book is $24.99. No subscriptions. No accounts required. Pick the company your child already knows.
